newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill lowers Stan Chart.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill lowers Stan Chart.

text.p: Standard Chartered Plc was cut to "accumulate" from "buy" at Merrill Lynch and earnings estimates for the Anglo-Asian banking group were also reduced, market sources said on Wednesday.
Merrill cut its 1996 pre-tax profit estimate to 874 million stg from 889 million and its 1997 estimate to 984 million stg from 1.002 billion, sources said.

The move comes after a series of downgrades from leading brokerages, sparked by comments from its broker Cazenove last week that growth may slow in key Asian markets -- though other analysts said a deceleration was already expected.
Yesterday analysts at HSBC James Capel lowered earnings forcasts while chart analysts at Robert Fleming moved the stock to a "sell."
The stock was up 2p at 656-1/2 by 1121 GMT, after bouncing from an early 11-1/2p decline to 643.
